full_chain.observation: Reskillable @Mod constructor installs API/provider; preInit dispatches sided proxy. CommonProxy registers LevelLockHandler/PlayerData events, initializes config and PacketHandler; postInit setupLocks builds actual keys. Registry subscriber creates/registers skills including concrete attack. Default config includes iron_sword wildcard attack5. Skill enabled/default cap32 and default PlayerSkillInfo level1 establish a concrete conditional denial example with that config, not only abstract callbacks. ItemInfo equality ignores metadata in hash but honors wildcard in equality, matching actual sword metadata; NBT/mod lock helpers fully read as context0.

LivingAttackEvent with true source EntityPlayer reads that actor current MAINHAND at damage event time, not necessarily original projectile weapon. genericEnforce skips noncancelable/null/empty/creative; default enforceFakePlayers includes fake denial but suppresses fake feedback, alternative skips fake. PlayerData.matchStats returnsfalse at first unmet requirement. Event is canceled and tellPlayer sends only to EntityPlayerMP. Default branch cancels before send; alternate sends before cancel. Other block/use/armor routes share categories but are not additional families. Current armor route is not canceling event; it copies/returns or drops invalid armor, clears armor slot then sends. No final aggregate result after every other mod handler is claimed.

MessageLockedItem constructor stores stack reference, not copy; byte codec serializes ItemStack and UTF8 message key only. No failing requirement, threshold, server level, target UUID, world, nonce or action generation. PacketHandler registers actual CLIENT handler. onMessage schedules on Minecraft task queue, handleMessage calls HUDHandler.setLockMessage. No local player/world/current item revalidation before updating static slot. ByteBufUtils/native network scheduling internals not expanded; do not assert enqueue-time immutable stack snapshot.

Login PlayerData.sync→API→ReskillableModAccess sends MessageDataSync with saveToNBT snapshot of SkillLevels. Client scheduled handler resolves current player through ClientProxy and loadFromNBT→PlayerSkillInfo overwrites level/points/unlocks for included skills. MessageLevelUp actual server handler can levelUp then saveAndSync after its gates; exact XP-helper internals not expanded or credited. No action ID binds these data packets to a particular MessageLockedItem. ConfigHandler reads local lock configuration; config-change load only replaces pending configLocks and does not itself call setupLocks. No same-time configuration/version field in refusal packet.

ClientProxy registers HUDHandler and ClientTickHandler. On overlay ALL while lockTime>0, HUD reads current local player data and LevelLockHandler.getSkillLock(lockedItem) every render. Draws translated refusal category header red, then skill icons and requested level numbers red/green according to current local skill level. GuiSkills.drawSkill uses current profile rank and texture; RenderHelper submits concrete textured quad. Thus packet reports rejection category/item while detailed condition explanation is reconstructed from current local definitions and independently synced profile, not server failure witness. It lists all local skill/advancement requirements, not only the one that failed.

full_chain.observation: RequirementRegistry supports skill, adv and trait; HUD separates only SkillRequirement and AdvancementRequirement. Trait/custom requirements still contribute restriction count/box size but are absent from shown detail list. Advancement icons/text show no achieved-state color check. An unresolved advancement causes return after outer pushMatrix and before matching final popMatrix; null display has no guard. This is a static incomplete-restore path, not a runtime graphics failure claim. Ordinary main skill text calls font renderer; translation resources/nativeGL/pixels not evaluated. No asset changed.

setLockMessage replaces static item/message and sets40 on every receipt, with no dedup or throttle. END client tick decrements only when currentScreen null or doesGuiPauseGame false. World-null branch only PlayerDataHandler.cleanup; no HUD clear, dimension/actor key, dead-player clear, successful retry clear or item-switch clear. lockTime<=0 prevents drawing; stored item/message refs are retained. Last<10 uses partialTicks alpha clamped minimum0.05. Repeated receipts can prolong display; pausing can preserve remaining clock. Rendering is not explicitly filtered Pre/Post beyond ElementType.ALL, so do not assert exactly one draw per frame.

critical_boundaries: Proposed distinction is split authority: real server denial plus client-reconstructed current detailed explanation. Not another single-slot/fade/cooldown value reference.
A green local requirement under refusal header is not proof server allowed action or target is immune. No server failed-condition snapshot is transmitted.
Actor eligibility is not Boss target immunity. No actual immune grey-text/audio implementation claimed; ordinary constitution rules unchanged.
Profile synchronization is separate and lacks refusal correlation; do not claim network reorder observed, config mismatch reproduced or guaranteed delivery.
No real server admission bypass demonstrated. LivingAttackEvent cancellation is actual mod action but native Forge dispatch/cross-mod uncancel policy not exhaustively expanded.
40-tick lifetime is pause-gated client ticks, not a wall-clock guarantee or server rate limit. Slots retained after hidden, no world cleanup in searched classes/callers.
Config-change callback load does not rebuild live lock map; do not assert immediate runtime config mutation from editing a file.
Advancement-null restore and missing trait rendering are concrete bounded source observations, not independent credits or production patches.
Copied RenderHelper explicitly attributes Botania; shared rendering helper context0, not a new author/source family.
